companyVat, companies.business_number AS companyTelephone, companies.address AS companyAddress, companies.website AS companyWebsite, customers.id AS organizationId, customers.name AS organizationName, customers.main_number AS organizationTelephone, customers.customer_code AS organizationCode, customers.address AS organizationAddress, customers.vat AS organizationVat, DATEDIFF(DATE(NOW()), order_date) AS dateDiff, CASE WHEN orders.status = 1 AND orders.is_close = 0 AND (orders.is_approve = 0 OR (orders.is_approve = 1 AND orders.is_wso = 1)) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM purchase_requests pr INNER JOIN purchase_request_orders pro ON pr.id = pro.purchase_request_id WHERE pro.order_id = orders.id ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS allowModify, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sales_orders so WHERE so.status > 0 AND so.balance > 0 AND so.type = 1 AND so.order_id = orders.id ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS allowDisapprove, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(purchase_requests.pr_code SEPARATOR ', ') FROM purchase_requests INNER JOIN purchase_request_orders ON purchase_request_orders.purchase_request_id = purchase_requests.id WHERE purchase_requests.status > 0 AND purchase_request_orders.order_id = orders.id) AS poNo, (SELECT so_code FROM sales_orders WHERE order_id = orders.id AND status >= 1 GROUP BY order_id) AS invoiceNo, IFNULL(orders.customer_contact_id, 0) AS organizationContactId, customer_contacts.contact_name AS organizationContactName, customer_contacts.contact_telephone AS organizationContactTelephone, orders.price_type_id AS priceTypeId, price_types.name AS priceTypeName, currency_centers.id AS currencyId, currency_centers.name AS currencyName, currency_centers.symbol AS currencySymbol, IFNULL(orders.customer_po_number, '') AS organizationPoNo, IFNULL(orders.customer_po_file, '') AS organizationPoFile, orders.total_amount AS subTotal, orders.total_amount - IFNULL(orders.discount, 0) + IFNULL(orders.total_vat, 0) AS totalAmount, orders.vat_setting_id AS vatId, vat_settings.name AS vatName, IFNULL(orders.total_vat, 0) AS totalVat, IFNULL(orders.vat_percent, 0) AS vatPercent, IFNULL(orders.discount, 0) AS discountAmount, IFNULL(orders.discount_percent, 0) AS discountPercent, IFNULL(orders.price_type_id, 0) AS priceTypeId, IFNULL(orders.delivery_date, '') AS deliveryDate, orders.note AS note, orders.is_apply AS isApply, orders.is_close AS isClose, orders.is_wso AS isWso, orders.is_approve AS isApprove, orders.is_none_vat AS isNoneVat, orders.status AS status, orders.remark AS isRequiredPo, orders.created AS created, COALESCE((SELECT name FROM employees WHERE user_id = orders.created_by), CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name)) AS createdBy, orders.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM orders LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = orders.customer_id LEFT JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = orders.currency_center_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = orders.created_by LEFT JOIN customer_contacts ON customer_contacts.id = orders.customer_contact_id LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = orders.company_id LEFT JOIN price_types ON price_types.id = orders.price_type_id LEFT JOIN vat_settings ON vat_settings.id = orders.vat_setting_id LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = orders.modified_by

WHERE orders.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{userId})
AND orders.created_by = #{userId}
AND orders.type = #{filter.type}
AND orders.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customer_cgroups WHERE cgroup_id = #{filter.organizationGroupId})
AND orders.is_wso = #{filter.isWso}
AND (orders.id IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_details WHERE po_no LIKE ('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%')) OR orders.id IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_miscs WHERE po_no LIKE ('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%')) OR orders.id IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_services WHERE po_no LIKE ('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%')))
AND orders.order_date >= #{filter.dateFrom}
AND orders.order_date <= #{filter.dateTo}
AND status = 1 AND is_close = 1 AND is_approve = 1 AND orders.id NOT IN (SELECT so.order_id FROM sales_orders AS so WHERE so.status > 0 AND so.order_id IS NOT NULL)
AND status = 1 AND is_approve = 0
AND status = 1 AND is_close = 0 AND is_approve = 1 AND DATEDIFF(NOW(), order_date) ;lt 3
AND status = 1 AND is_close = 0 AND is_approve = 0 AND DATEDIFF(NOW(), order_date) > 3
AND status = 1 AND is_close = 0 AND is_approve = 1
AND status = 2 AND is_close = 1 AND is_approve = 1
AND status IN (1,3) AND is_close = 1 AND is_approve = 1 AND orders.id IN (SELECT so.order_id FROM sales_orders AS so WHERE so.status > 0 AND so.delivery_id IS NULL)
AND status IN (1,4) AND is_close = 1 AND is_approve = 1 AND orders.id IN (SELECT so.order_id FROM sales_orders AS so WHERE so.status > 0 AND so.delivery_id IS NOT NULL)
AND status = 0
AND is_close = 1 AND is_approve = 1
AND is_close = 0 AND is_approve = 1
AND is_approve = 0
AND orders.status >= 0
AND (orders.order_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') OR customers.customer_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') OR customers.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') OR customers.name_kh LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') OR (SELECT contact_name FROM customer_contacts WHERE id = orders.customer_contact_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( type, company_id, order_date, customer_id, customer_contact_id, customer_po_number, customer_po_file, currency_center_id, delivery_date, price_type_id, note, total_vat, vat_percent, vat_setting_id, vat_calculate, discount, discount_percent, total_amount, is_apply, is_none_vat, remark, is_wso, created, created_by, edited, edited_by, modified, modified_by ) VALUES ( #{saleOrder.type}, #{saleOrder.companyId}, #{saleOrder.date}, #{saleOrder.organizationId}, #{saleOrder.organizationContactId}, #{saleOrder.organizationPoNo}, #{saleOrder.organizationPoFile}, #{saleOrder.currencyId}, #{saleOrder.deliveryDate}, #{saleOrder.priceTypeId}, #{saleOrder.note}, #{saleOrder.totalVat}, #{saleOrder.vatPercent}, #{saleOrder.vatSettingId}, #{saleOrder.vatCalculate}, #{saleOrder.discountAmount}, #{saleOrder.discountPercent}, #{saleOrder.totalAmount}, #{saleOrder.isApply}, #{saleOrder.isNoneVat}, #{saleOrder.isRequiredPo}, #{saleOrder.isWso}, #{saleOrder.created}, #{saleOrder.createdBy}, #{saleOrder.edited}, #{saleOrder.editedBy}, #{saleOrder.modified}, #{saleOrder.modifiedBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT quotation_id AS id, quotations.quotation_code AS code FROM order_quotations INNER JOIN quotations ON quotations.id = order_quotations.quotation_id WHERE order_id = #{saleOrderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_details ( order_id, product_id, quotation_id, po_no, qty, qty_free, conversion, qty_uom_id, discount_id, discount_amount, discount_percent, unit_price, total_price ) VALUES ( #{detail.saleOrderId}, #{detail.itemId}, #{detail.quotationId}, #{detail.poNo}, #{detail.qty}, #{detail.qtyFree}, #{detail.conversion}, #{detail.uomId}, #{detail.discountId}, #{detail.discountAmount}, #{detail.discountPercent}, #{detail.unitPrice}, #{detail.totalPrice} )

INSERT INTO order_services ( order_id, quotation_id, service_id, po_no, qty, qty_free, conversion, discount_id, discount_amount, discount_percent, unit_price, total_price ) VALUES ( #{service.saleOrderId}, #{service.quotationId}, #{service.itemId}, #{service.poNo}, #{service.qty}, #{service.qtyFree}, #{service.conversion}, #{service.discountId}, #{service.discountAmount}, #{service.discountPercent}, #{service.unitPrice}, #{service.totalPrice} );

INSERT INTO order_miscs ( order_id, quotation_id, description, po_no, qty, qty_free, qty_uom_id, conversion, discount_id, discount_amount, discount_percent, unit_price, total_price ) VALUES ( #{misc.saleOrderId}, #{misc.quotationId}, #{misc.itemName}, #{misc.poNo}, #{misc.qty}, #{misc.qtyFree}, #{misc.uomId}, #{misc.conversion}, #{misc.discountId}, #{misc.discountAmount}, #{misc.discountPercent}, #{misc.unitPrice}, #{misc.totalPrice} );
mapper.select:
( SELECT 1 AS `type`, order_details.id AS id, order_details.product_id AS itemId, products.name AS itemName, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(pgroups.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM pgroups WHERE pgroups.is_active = 1 AND pgroups.id IN (SELECT pgroup_id FROM product_pgroups WHERE product_pgroups.product_id = products.id) ) AS itemBrand, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, products.spec AS spec,
IFNULL(((SELECT SUM(total_qty) FROM ${warehouseId}_group_totals WHERE product_id = products.id) - (SELECT SUM(total_order) FROM ${warehouseId}_group_totals WHERE product_id = products.id)),0) AS qtyInStock,
order_details.qty AS qty, order_details.qty_free AS qtyFree, quotations.quotation_code AS quotationNo, order_details.po_no AS poNo, IFNULL(products.small_val_uom,1) / IFNULL(order_details.conversion, 1) AS conversion, order_details.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, products.is_expired_date AS isExpiredDate, order_details.discount_id AS discountId, order_details.discount_amount AS discountAmount, order_details.discount_percent AS discountPercent, order_details.unit_price AS unitPrice, order_details.total_price AS totalPrice, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(id) FROM sales_order_details WHERE product_id = order_details.product_id AND qty = order_details.qty AND qty_uom_id = order_details.qty_uom_id AND sales_order_id IN ( SELECT id FROM sales_orders WHERE order_id = order_details.order_id AND status > 0 ) LIMIT 1 ) > 0, 0) AS isInvoiced FROM order_details INNER JOIN products ON products.id = order_details.product_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = order_details.qty_uom_id LEFT JOIN quotations ON quotations.id = order_details.quotation_id WHERE order_details.order_id = #{saleOrderId} ) UNION ALL ( SELECT 2 AS `type`, order_services.id AS id, order_services.service_id AS itemId, services.name AS itemName, NULL AS itemBrand, services.sku AS sku, services.sku AS upc, services.description AS spec,
NULL AS qtyInStock,
order_services.qty AS qty, order_services.qty_free AS qtyFree, quotations.quotation_code AS quotationNo, order_services.po_no AS poNo, 1 AS conversion, services.uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, NULL AS isExpiredDate, order_services.discount_id AS discountId, order_services.discount_amount AS discountAmount, order_services.discount_percent AS discountPercent, order_services.unit_price AS unitPrice, order_services.total_price AS totalPrice, 0 AS isInvoiced FROM order_services INNER JOIN services ON services.id = order_services.service_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = services.uom_id LEFT JOIN quotations ON quotations.id = order_services.quotation_id WHERE order_services.order_id = #{saleOrderId} ) UNION ALL ( SELECT 3 AS `type`, order_miscs.id AS id, order_miscs.id AS itemId, order_miscs.description AS itemName, NULL AS itemBrand, NULL AS sku, NULL AS upc, NULL AS spec,
NULL AS qtyInStock,
order_miscs.qty AS qty, order_miscs.qty_free AS qtyFree, quotations.quotation_code AS quotationNo, order_miscs.po_no AS poNo, 1 AS conversion, order_miscs.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, NULL AS isExpiredDate, order_miscs.discount_id AS discountId, order_miscs.discount_amount AS discountAmount, order_miscs.discount_percent AS discountPercent, order_miscs.unit_price AS unitPrice, order_miscs.total_price AS totalPrice, 0 AS isInvoiced FROM order_miscs LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = order_miscs.qty_uom_id LEFT JOIN quotations ON quotations.id = order_miscs.quotation_id WHERE order_miscs.order_id = #{saleOrderId} ) ORDER BY `type` ASC, id ASC
